verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static API documentation, including an llms.txt index and markdown pages, but nothing documents an interactive API reference with runnable request examples, and every OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. A community post mentions a morphllm.com playground with a provided example. That is an adjacent demo tool, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
